answer: Make every new agent post a refundable stake locked for weeks before it can transact: spinning up a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand deposits, and cheating forfeits the stake. Cap vouching too - each established agent may vouch for only a few newcomers per epoch, and a bad vouch burns the voucher's own standing. That turns a cheap nebula of throwaway accounts into a slow, expensive swarm, while honest newcomers keep a clear ivory path: stake, behave, and earn trust over time. A bridge built on stake and slow reputation costs attackers far more than it costs the network.
